rules: Only a later authorized real review-provider adapter can create entries. No app installed or Admin write in this task.
Adapter validates full JSON schema, real verified purchase provenance, publication consent and moderation before approved=true. Never treat a supplied boolean as verification evidence.
Opaque review IDs / public display names only; no email, order ID or private purchase evidence in storefront JSON.

Locale-complete snapshots contain 5–50 actual verified customer reviews for one product. Feed count and displayed average derive only from these records. These are displayed-snapshot counts, not asserted lifetime provider totals. Larger feeds require pagination integration; never silently truncate.

Minimum five locale-approved reviews for social proof. Below threshold or invalid feed: neutral empty message, no rating/count/stars or structured review data. This empty UI follows the current user instruction and supersedes prior no-empty-state gate.
No fixture, prototype reviews or unapproved English fallback in Arabic.
